package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserLoggedInData(
    String email,
    Map<String, Object> federatedClaims,
    Map<String, Object> flowcatalystClaims,
    String identityProviderCode,
    String loginMethod,
    String userId
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserLoggedInData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserLoggedInData(
            (String) map.get("email"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("federatedClaims"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("flowcatalystClaims"),
            (String) map.get("identityProviderCode"),
            (String) map.get("loginMethod"),
            (String) map.get("userId")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("email", email);
        map.put("federatedClaims", federatedClaims);
        map.put("flowcatalystClaims", flowcatalystClaims);
        map.put("identityProviderCode", identityProviderCode);
        map.put("loginMethod", loginMethod);
        map.put("userId", userId);
        return map;
    }
}
